UPDATE onboarding_sequences
SET step = step + 1,
    next_send_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day',
    completed = (step + 1) >= 5
WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}'
UPDATE onboarding_sequences SET completed_at = NOW() WHERE org_id = '{{ $json.org_id }}'

parameters.query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.last_login, u.status,
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - u.last_login) as days_inactive
FROM users u
WHERE u.last_login < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND u.status = 'active'

SELECT f.question, f.answer, f.category
FROM faq f
WHERE f.active = true
AND similarity(f.question, '{{ $json.message }}') > 0.3
ORDER BY similarity(f.question, '{{ $json.message }}') DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.plan, s.status, s.current_period_end
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.org_id = '{{ $json.org_id }}'
AND s.status = 'active'
LIMIT 1
